title: Grave/Digger Items
description: Adds Items from Grave/Digger to Minecraft
body:
A resource pack that allows you to change Iron spears into Heavy Lances! 
No additional mods needed.

**How to use it?**
Rename your Item in an anvil to either of the listed names to receive a new look!!


<details>
<summary>Item Name list</summary>


## **Iron/Diamond/Netherite Spear:**

```
Empire Lance
Empire Heavy Lance
```
```
Nation Lance
Nation Heavy Lance
```

## **Shields:**
```
Empire Bulwark Shield
Empire Vanguard Shield
```
```
Nation Bulwark Shield
Nation Vanguard Shield
```

## **Stick:** (yes we are renaming a stick for this)
Rally Banners + Wall Variant:
```
Empire Rally Banner
Empire Rally Wall Banner
```
```
Nation Rally Banner
Nation Rally Wall Banner
```

</details>



![All Variants of the Heavy Lances](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/KV0g0w5G/images/7dfcf0f36aad8e648cd76d48e388691e88e33eb5.png)

![Displaying Bulwark shields with damage variants and Rally Banners ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/KV0g0w5G/images/47897ecc4cb97f92ac427506eb780f7a2c17d098.png)

More items may follow in the future!


All items based on [Grave/Digger on Roblox by Archeximus](https://www.roblox.com/games/18259975825/Grave-Digger).
